summary.motive: Create immediate interior pressure against slide protections by sending a two-man A-gap cross-dog stunt where the first linebacker picks the center and the second loops untouched to the quarterback.
summary.keyDefender: WILL (Looping A-Gap Blitzer) & MIKE (Penetrating Center Picker)
summary.whyItWorks: Offensive linemen cannot pass off interior stunt crosses in tight A-gap spacing, and running backs struggle to adjust to looping rush tracks.
summary.failureMode: A quick slip screen or tunnel screen that catches the interior rushers vacating the second level.

beats.title: Double-A Mug 6-Up Presentation
beats.text: Todd Bowles mugs both inside linebackers (MIKE and WILL) directly into the A-gaps, forcing the offensive line into a man-to-man 5-0 protection check.

beats.title: The Cross-Dog Exchange
beats.text: At the snap, MIKE slams into the left shoulder of the Center to occupy him, while WILL executes a delayed cross-loop behind him into the opposite A-gap.

beats.title: The Running Back Whiffs, Gap Opens
beats.text: The running back expects a direct blitz and is caught off-guard by the looping angle of WILL, leaving the A-gap wide open as WILL accelerates into the backfield.

beats.title: Interior Sack in Under 2.2 Seconds
beats.text: WILL buries the quarterback before he can hit his hot slant against tight press-man coverage, delivering a vintage Todd Bowles drive-ending sack.

relations.tell: Both inside linebackers mug A-gaps at snap, with MIKE charging first and WILL crossing behind his back into opposite gap
